snippet.title: [First GamePlay Video] Guns are Funs - Updated
snippet.description:
Add our game "Guns are Funs" to your "wishlist" on Steam

Добавьте нашу игру "Пушки не Игрушки" в "желаемые" в Steam

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003640?utm_source=YT
VK Play - https://vkplay.ru/play/game/pushki_ne_igrushki/

Voiceover - Nikichar:

- https://t.me/NikicharTheEmpire
- https://vk.com/nikichar
- https://goodgame.ru/Nikichar

Welcome to the game Guns are Funs. You control an artillery crew whose goal is to destroy the toy towers of the red soldiers who have captured the territory of the green soldiers. The command has allocated you a powerful toy gun with which you can accomplish your goal.

It just so happens that as soon as we leave home or go to bed, the toys come to life and begin to beat each other up, trying to seize control over the entire territory of your home. Our soldiers are no exception. Now it's up to you - arm yourself with guns and superpowers and hit the enemy soldiers hard.
Go through levels, collect resources from broken enemy fortifications, which you can then spend on improving your gun, purchasing shells, and acquiring new abilities.
And if suddenly you don’t have enough resources, feel free to go on a raid on the enemy camp and steal as many resources as possible to continue the siege of towers and castles!

Guns are Funs is a fun and exciting arcade game for children and adults. Test yourself for accuracy, coordination and logical thinking.

#gamedev #indiegames #vk #vkplay #yandex #yandexgames #gunsarefuns #пушкинеигрушки

Ссылка на DonationAlerts - https://www.donationalerts.com/r/3dcubetutorials

Ваша лучшая поддержка это подписка, лайк, комментарий, спонсорство :)
